summary: Tested 9 features for iteration 143: Social media icons moved from header to footer, checkout loyalty/wallet redemption, Profile page tabs. All features verified via UI testing and code review.
critical_code_review_comments: Header is clean - only Share and Staff Portal buttons visible, no social media icons
Footer has beautiful pill-shaped social media buttons (Instagram, Facebook, Threads) with correct URLs
UnifiedCheckout.jsx has Apply Rewards section with loyalty points and wallet balance toggles (lines 405-470)
Profile.js has functional Family Profiles modal (FamilyProfiles.jsx) - NOT 'coming soon'
Profile.js has functional Subscription Refills modal (SubscriptionRefills.jsx) - NOT 'coming soon'
Profile.js has functional Wallet tab with balance display and transaction history
Profile.js About Us link correctly navigates to /about page
Share as PDF functionality exists in handleSharePrescription method using jsPDF

1_header_clean.details: ServiceHeader.jsx has only Share button (data-testid='share-app-btn') and Staff Portal button (data-testid='staff-portal-btn'). No social media icons in header.
1_header_clean.evidence: Screenshot shows clean header with Share icon and Staff Portal

2_footer_social_buttons.details: Footer.jsx has beautiful pill-shaped social buttons at lines 217-252

3_checkout_apply_rewards.details: UnifiedCheckout.jsx lines 405-470 has 'Apply Rewards' section with conditional rendering when loyaltyPoints > 0 or walletBalance > 0
3_checkout_apply_rewards.note: Toggle buttons show loyalty points value (pts = ₹X value) and wallet balance (₹X available)

4_checkout_order_summary_discounts.details: Order summary at lines 369-403 shows loyalty discount and wallet discount line items when applied, with Star and Wallet icons

5_profile_family_profiles.details: FamilyProfiles component is fully functional modal - can add/delete family members with relationship types, blood groups, gender selection. NOT showing 'coming soon'

6_profile_prescriptions_pdf.details: Profile.js has handleSharePrescription method (lines 220-318) that generates PDF using jsPDF with Nevika Cura branding and allows sharing via WhatsApp or download

7_profile_subscription_refills.details: SubscriptionRefills component is fully functional modal - can manage auto-refills with pause/resume/cancel. NOT showing 'coming soon'

8_profile_wallet_tab.details: Profile.js has WalletTab component (lines 1111-1174) showing balance (data-testid='wallet-balance'), transaction history with gift_cash/topup/debit types

9_profile_about_us_link.details: Profile.js line 1039 has About Us MenuItem that navigates to /about page correctly. About page verified at /about with dark theme, social icons, Nevika Cura LLP branding

context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from this batch verified. Social icons moved from header to footer (ServiceHeader clean, Footer has social section). Checkout rewards redemption at /checkout?type=pharmacy requires items in cart and logged-in user with loyalty points/wallet balance. Profile page modals (FamilyProfiles, SubscriptionRefills) are fully functional components, not coming soon placeholders.
